text:
Silver Price in 2014
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2014, the LBMA silver price fell 17.3% between 2014-01-31 ($19.31) and 2014-12-31 ($15.97). The highest sampled price was $21.27 in February and the lowest was $15.97 in November. The mean of these observations was $18.76. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
